truth_boundary: This inventory maps every R0 material boundary to source wiring and executable shared/pure authorization tests where they exist. A shared-gate test is partial criterion evidence, not proof that every physical handler and deployed provider effect is authorized end-to-end.
closure_rule: No route closes unless its complete handler-to-effect path is locally exercised, non-owner and unknown actors are non-enumerably denied where applicable, authority outages/ambiguity fail closed, and deployed runtime evidence exists.
